name: Luna 24
intro: Zdravstvuyte! Luna 24 here, the last Soviet Moon robot.
I carry a drill that goes two metres deep. Twist, twist, twist!
Grab the core, fire it home. One day on the surface is enough.
briefing: We are over Mare Crisium, the Sea of Crises. Sounds scary, right?
Choose where I land for my one-day drilling job.
fact: Luna 24's soil was the last Moon sample brought to Earth for 44 years.
